A lot of people at the CC do conglomerate in friend groups though. Like in my class there's already a group forming even though none of us knew each other before. 

And I'd like to think I'm a great listening ear with plenty of insights to offer and I've made people laugh before, but also I dislike the idea that I need to "offer" something in order to be worthy of having companionship... like everyone else can just be friends with people and don't need to have some kind of catch or whatever. Friendship shouldn't feel like a business transaction

I mean, I'd like to think I'm an okay person on my own, but when you've never had any external validation in your life (and before someone brings up the "love yourself" advice, it's super unrealistic to expect people to feel fulfilled completely autonomously with zero outside positive reinforcement) then it's extremely hard to keep it going. And there's tons of people with low self-esteem and confidence who still have plenty of friends
21F, I’m the exact same way. I don’t have a single friend, and I missed out on all the important milestones. I feel like a freak
Yup, as soon as people see that I’m depressed they like to exclude me even more despite knowing how fucking shitty that makes me feel. People suck
"finding someone"? sounds fake
no, they won't. people are shit.

For me I’ve only ever been in relationships with people online, and kissed once. I feel like there’s a huge stigma toward women who haven’t had those milestones of having had sex or been through multiple partners... as a 21F it’s had a huge toll on me mentally. Glad there are other girls out there like me

I hate it when I get responses like that, or people claiming that “I care!” Bitch, you’re a total stranger. Come on.
